title: 第181章 小货车被一群猎人丧尸追击？
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老九右手正握着唐横刀，左手稳稳地操控着车头，哪怕转弯也很稳。

他浑身不断散发出红色的雾气，还带着浓烈的铁锈味，像一头浴血的狮子。

特别是那眼神，面对不断扑来的C级猎人不仅没有丝毫害怕，反而是极致的冷静。

就好像...老九他真的参与过无数生死的搏斗。

一头头妄想扑击小电驴的C级猎人，都被老九一刀砍断！

干脆利落！

老九挥出唐横刀时，建筑工人服装下的前臂肌肉松松垮垮。

可一旦刀尖就要触碰到猎人的身体时，老九整条前臂的肌肉会骤然绷紧！

甚至青筋暴起！

挥刀的惯性再加上突然的发力，唐横刀刀尖好似鞭子的末端，直接如切豆腐般，划破猎人的身体。

黑褐色的鲜血随着惯性，直接溅射在粉色小电驴上，也溅射在老九脸上和身上。

可老九毫不在意，甚至已经习惯了...

但每次砍死一头C级的猎人时，老九都会满脸得意地问小九这么一句：

“老子帅不帅？！”

“都说了，我打架很牛的！”

“老子年轻时，可是被一群人叫浩南哥的！”

小九自然觉得老九帅呆了，但他不会亲口承认，只是白了老九一眼。

当然，他也不信老九真的被人叫过浩南哥。

他只觉得老九在吹牛逼罢了！

不然老九你这么厉害，为什么那些垃圾欺负你的时候不打回去？！

这男人，穿越前一直都老实本分，甚至是唯唯诺诺的，连被人欺负到头上，都只是一味地陪笑。

可现在呢？

从穿越到现在的一路上，老九面对丧尸的冷静，以及很实用的刀法，都让小九觉得老九像是换了一个人。

被老九砍死的猎人，直接爆出3枚求生币。

求生币叮叮当当地在公路上弹跳着。

其它猎人就匍匐在公路旁的草丛里，等着小电驴经过。

它们眼睛几乎看不见，靠的是听力。

一旦锁定载具，猎人的喉咙便会爆发出怒吼，然后朝着玩家的载具扑去！

如果扑击没中，它们会继续追击。

小九也没有闲着，他握着金属棒球棍，边盯着两侧草丛给老九报点位，边预防身后的猎人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lao Jiu was holding Tang Hengdao in his right hand, and his left hand was steadily controlling the front of the car, even when turning.

His whole body was constantly emitting red mist, with a strong smell of rust, like a lion bathed in blood.

Especially that look in his eyes. Not only was he not afraid at all when facing the C-level hunters that kept coming at him, but he was extremely calm.

It's like... Lao Jiu has really participated in countless life and death battles.

The C-level hunters who tried to pounce on the little electric donkey were all cut off by Lao Jiu!

Simple and neat!

When Lao Jiu swung the Tang Hengdao, the muscles in his forearm under the construction worker's clothes were loose.

But once the tip of the knife is about to touch the hunter's body, the muscles in Lao Jiu's entire forearm will suddenly tighten!

Even the veins popped out!

The inertia of swinging the knife coupled with the sudden force, the tip of Tang Hengdao was like the end of a whip, slicing through the hunter's body like tofu.

The dark brown blood followed the inertia and splashed directly on the pink eDonkey, and also splashed on Lao Jiu's face and body.

But Lao Jiu didn't care, he was even used to it...

But every time he killed a C-level hunter, Lao Jiu would ask Xiao Jiu with a proud face:

"Isn't I handsome?!"

"As I said, I'm very good at fighting!"

"When I was young, I was called Brother Haonan by a group of people!"

Xiao Jiu naturally felt that Lao Jiu was extremely handsome, but he would not admit it personally and just gave Lao Jiu a blank look.

Of course, he didn't believe that Lao Jiu had actually been called Brother Haonan.

He just thought Lao Jiu was bragging!

Otherwise, Lao Jiu, you are so powerful, why don't you fight back when those trash bullies bully you?!

This man, before time travel, had always been honest and submissive. Even when he was bullied to the point of being bullied, he would just laugh.

But now?

From the journey to the present, Lao Jiu's calmness when facing zombies and his practical knife skills made Xiao Jiu feel that Lao Jiu seemed like a different person.

The hunter who was hacked to death by Lao Jiu directly exploded 3 survival coins.

Survival coins jingled and bounced on the road.

Other hunters were lying in the grass beside the road, waiting for the little electric donkey to pass by.

They are almost blind and rely on their hearing.

Once the vehicle is locked, a roar will erupt from the hunter's throat, and then he will rush towards the player's vehicle!

If the pounce misses, they will continue to pursue.

Xiao Jiu was not idle either. He was holding a metal baseball bat, staring at the grass on both sides to report the position to Lao Jiu, and guarding against the hunters behind him.
